podcast.title: Co-author of Music Response
podcast.body: Misielio collaborated with the obscure artist Manicol on a song that, despite not achieving success, contained "tiny fragments" that were later sampled by The Chemical Brothers for their track "Music Response." The inclusion of these nearly imperceptible samples legally required Misielio to be credited as a co-author of "Music Response." "y que les obligó poner a mi silvió como coutora de lo que vuelve el music response."
